auth.registerLead: Register once, connect your provider, and launch your first collaborative event playlist.
auth.loginHint: Use your host credentials to continue.
auth.registerHint: Use a valid email and a secure password.

profile.title: Customize your host profile and workspace defaults.
profile.description: Manage your avatar, preferred provider, language, appearance and security settings from one place.
profile.avatarManagedInHeader: Avatar can be updated from the profile header.

dashboard.title: Manage your live playlist events from one place.
dashboard.description: Track your host session, jump into events, check provider connections, and inspect your profile payload while building the MVP flow.
dashboard.sessionActiveBody: Your host session is ready. You can continue creating and moderating events.

hero.title: Collaborative event playlists, without forcing guests to sign up.
hero.description: Synqit gives hosts a shareable link. Guests open it, search songs, and contribute in seconds while tracks land directly in the host provider playlist.
hero.helper: Built for fast guest contribution on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

why.title: Why hosts choose Synqit for event playlists
why.description: Structured for clarity and speed: create, share, collect tracks, moderate.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Connect provider, create the event playlist, and generate a magic link.
how.step2Body: Guests open the link and contribute songs from the host provider catalog.
how.step3Body: Host reviews tracks, removes items, and closes the event when ready.

cards.hostBody: Connect provider, create event, copy the magic link in under a minute.
cards.guestBody: Guests open the link, search tracks, and contribute without account creation.
cards.providerBody: Tracks are searched against and added to the host provider account directly.

finalCta.pill: Ready to test your first event?
finalCta.title: Launch a host event and start collecting tracks today.
finalCta.description: Start with your own account, connect your provider, and share one link with guests.

footer.description: Collaborative event playlists with one magic link and live host moderation.
